checks.setup: Front oblique and side sheets inspected; complete body and apparatus visible.
checks.hands: Both closed hands stay on machine handles.
checks.feet: Standing left foot supports body; right knee flexes against a plate-loaded roller. Fixed torso, thigh support, heel path and roller contact checked.
checks.movement: Single right leg knee curl from 180 to 80 degrees, torso leaning forward 30 degrees, fixed thigh pad and hand grips, left foot on platform, ankle roller and plate-loaded side lever. Four seconds curl and four seconds return; switch legs between sets.

limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative. Holds show the maintained position only; entry and exit are not animated.
